description: Linger is An Open-Source Personal Agent That Runs Fully on Your PC.  We aim to break Big Tech’s grip on AI by bringing powerful local AI to everyday computers through efficient model–harness co-design, so everyone can run their own.

latest_release.name: Linger Desktop 0.1.11 (Beta)
latest_release.body:
Linger Desktop 0.1.11 (Beta) for macOS (Apple silicon), Windows x64 and Linux x64.

> [!NOTE]
> The Linger desktop app is currently in **Beta** and under active development. You may run into rough edges during installation or updates (for example, Windows SmartScreen warnings while the Windows installer is unsigned, or a longer first-run setup while local runtimes and models download). If something fails, see [Install the desktop app](https://docs.heylinger.com/install/desktop-app), ask in [Discord](https://discord.gg/bmgnw6pdZ7), or [open an issue](https://github.com/simplexai-labs/linger/issues).

| Platform | Download | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- |
| macOS (Apple silicon, 14.0+) | [Linger-0.1.11-macos-arm64.dmg](https://github.com/simplexai-labs/linger/releases/download/desktop-v0.1.11/Linger-0.1.11-macos-arm64.dmg) | Signed and notarized; drag to Applications |
| Windows (x64) | [Linger-0.1.11-windows-x64-setup.exe](https://github.com/simplexai-labs/linger/releases/download/desktop-v0.1.11/Linger-0.1.11-windows-x64-setup.exe) | Per-user installer (no admin required); [portable zip](https://github.com/simplexai-labs/linger/releases/download/desktop-v0.1.11/Linger-0.1.11-windows-x64-portable.zip) also available |
| Linux (x64, glibc 2.35+) | [Linger-0.1.11-linux-x64.tar.gz](https://github.com/simplexai-labs/linger/releases/download/desktop-v0.1.11/Linger-0.1.11-linux-x64.tar.gz) | Extract and run |

Check downloads against [`SHA256SUMS.txt`](https://github.com/simplexai-labs/linger/releases/download/desktop-v0.1.11/SHA256SUMS.txt). `Linger-0.1.11-macos-arm64.app.tar.gz`, `manifest.json`, and `manifest.json.sig` are used by the built-in auto-updater.

## Highlights

- **Faster first-run setup, smaller installers, and quicker updates (#738, #741, #764, #772, #814, #815).** Packages now bundle the Pi 1.5.2 runtime directly, deduplicate Node.js, and ship a minimal offline source skeleton, cutting installer size and removing npm downloads during setup. API Key setup no longer waits for local-model hardware checks, voice tools unpack in the background on first install, and updates pre-stage files and keep warm local services running during Windows self-updates to shorten restart time.
- **Redesigned Settings → Computers, Settings → Models, and Desktop Setup (#787, #822).** **Settings → Computers** presents Agents and Harnesses in single-row horizontal scroll rails with official brand icons. **Settings → Models** unifies the local model library into **Installed** and **Available** sections with inline **Switch** controls and simplifies API key setup with a compact 3-field form and saved-connection summary card (inline **Test**, **Edit**, and **Switch**). First-run Setup adds API key provider presets, detected Harness badges, and a redesigned **Install location** bar with dynamic disk-space checks across all platforms.
- **Full Antigravity runtime parity and idle compaction for Pi and Antigravity (#785, #786, #794, #813).** Antigravity Agents now run in isolated per-Agent runtime homes with native transcript history, Agent Memory support, missed-reply and command guards, running-turn steer, and per-model context-window and usage reporting. Both Pi and Antigravity now compact idle sessions automatically in the background to keep long-running conversations lean.
- **Simpler Room creation, Runtime settings, Connectors, and automatic file previews (#782, #799, #803, #831, #835, #838).** **Create Room** now opens a new Room immediately (`New Room`) and goes straight to adding members, with in-place renaming in the refreshed **Room settings** panel. **Runtime settings** and **Create local agent** use shared dropdown selects with Runtime logos and readiness states (preselecting a Computer automatically), **Connectors** uses a single filter row with a **Connected only** toggle and compact API key dialogs, and previewable files or Documents delivered by Agents now open automatically in the Room side panel.

detail.readme:
Linger is an open-source personal agent with a Claude-class brain running locally on your PC.

Open-Source  ·  Local AI  ·  Consumer Macs & PCs

- **A Claude-class brain, running locally.** A 125B model on a 12 GB GPU, on everyday Macs and PCs. - **The Grok Bot experience on your PC.** Zero token fees for local inference. - **A loyal AI sidekick.** It remembers what matters, proactively gets things done, and keeps your data on your device. ## Cool features ### Local models: A Claude-class brain on a 12 GB GPU Efficient AI model–harness co-design brings a full local agent to consumer Macs and PCs. Our MoE inference engine, PolyStrata, keeps a model's busiest experts on your GPU and the rest in RAM or on SSD, so larger models run with less GPU memory: the **125B** Qwen3.8-Flash-Next runs on a **12 GB card** with 64 GB of RAM. The model runs on your own machine instead of a remote server, so there is no cloud bill and no token fee.

Full results (**5 more models**!) can be found in [PolyStrata](https://github.com/simplexai-labs/PolyStrata#how-fast-is-it).
### Model Autopilot: The smartest model your machine can run One command detects your hardware, recommends the best model, installs it and checks it. In our lab we run an architecture search: 49 language models, two inference engines, quantizations from 1-bit to 8-bit and context windows from 64K to 256K, tested tier by tier on NVIDIA cards and Macs. On your computer, the installer reads your GPU, memory and bandwidth, keeps only what fits with at least a 64K context, picks the smartest model and then the fastest, and counts it as installed only after it answers a real question.

Full benchmarks, test conditions, and scoring details: [docs.heylinger.com/hardware/benchmarks](https://docs.heylinger.com/hardware/benchmarks).
### Wiki and memory: It remembers your business Tell one agent, and every agent knows. Another Me reads back through your inbox, then each night files your mail, chats and meetings into wiki pages that every agent can search. It keeps the information, preferences and decisions that matter across conversations, on your device instead of in a provider's account.
How it works: your sources become wiki pages every night, and every agent searches them
### Proactive Another Me: It speaks up when it matters It reaches out first. Another Me watches your inbox, calendar and Slack, follows up and moves work forward, and messages you only when something needs you. And it improves itself recursively: every night it reads how its own messages landed and rewrites the rules it decides by, so every "not now" makes tomorrow's judgment sharper. #### How it learns: recursive self-improvement, every night Every message Another Me sends on its own is also a test. Each night, Dreaming reads how those messages landed and rewrites the rules Another Me decides by; the next day it decides with the new rules, and how those land feeds the next night. No retraining: what it learned stays a short list of rules.
Implicit reinforcement: push back on the same kind twice, and it becomes a rule You never state the rule; Another Me reads it from how you react. Want it sooner twice, and it tells you right away; turn it down twice, and it stays quiet.
Direct response: say how you want it, and one Dreaming makes it a rule No second time needed. Name the kind and it changes whether you are told; name the hour and it changes when.
### More features - **[Desktop and browser](docs/desktop-and-browser.md):** Your apps, your Chrome, already signed in. Agents open the apps on your Mac, Windows PC or Linux desktop and click and type the way you do, and on a Mac or Windows PC they work in your everyday Chrome with the sign-ins you already have. - **[Agent teams](docs/team-md.md):** One plan for every agent. When a job needs more than one agent, Another Me brings in the agents you have, creates the ones it is missing, and writes one `team.md` that they all follow. - **[Task delegation](docs/task-delegation.md):** Long work runs in the background while the chat stays with you. An agent hands long work to background copies of itself and keeps talking with you while the work runs. - **[Model scheduling](docs/model-scheduling.md):** One model, many agents, your work first. Every agent, approval and background job shares the local model, so work you are waiting for starts at once and background work waits until the model is quiet. - **[Bring your own runtime](docs/local-inference.md):** Claude Code, Codex or Pi, on your GPU or your subscription. Each runs as it always does, on local models or on the plan you already pay for. - **[Voice](docs/voice.md):** Record a meeting with a live transcript, ask what was said, and hand the follow-ups to Another Me. ## Quick start ### Option 1: the desktop app (Beta) > [!NOTE] > The desktop app is currently in **Beta** and under active development. You may > run into rough edges during installation or updates (for example, Windows > SmartScreen warnings while the Windows installer is unsigned, or a longer > first-run setup while local runtimes and models download). If something fails, > see [Install the desktop app](https://docs.heylinger.com/install/desktop-app), > ask in [Discord](https://discord.gg/bmgnw6pdZ7), or > [open an issue](https://github.com/simplexai-labs/linger/issues). For one person on one computer. Choose your platform below. The app opens Linger, connects this computer and runs its agents. **Quick Install** on its setup screen sets up a Linger server on this computer too. | Platform | Package | | ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | | [macOS 14.0 or later, Apple silicon](https://github.com/simplexai-labs/linger/releases/latest) | `Linger--macos-arm64.dmg` | | [Windows x64](https://github.com/simplexai-labs/linger/releases/latest) | `Linger--windows-x64-setup.exe`, or `-windows-x64-portable.zip` to run without installing | | [Linux x64](https://github.com/simplexai-labs/linger/releases/latest) | `Linger--linux-x64.tar.gz` (glibc 2.35 or newer) | There is no package for Intel Macs; use Docker Compose there. Check each download against `SHA256SUMS.txt` from the same release. See [Install the desktop app](https://docs.heylinger.com/install/desktop-app) for the install steps and for help when setup fails. ### Option 2: Docker Compose For a server that several computers share, or to build from source. You need Docker with Compose and at least 5 GiB of memory for its virtual machine. ```bash git clone https://github.com/simplexai-labs/linger.git cd linger cp .env.example .env docker compose up --build --detach --wait ``` Create the owner account. As written, it signs in as `owner@linger.local` with the test password `test1234`; replace either one to use your own: ```bash printf '%s\n' 'test1234' | docker compose exec -T teamhub \ teamhub-account create-owner --email owner@linger.local --password-stdin ``` Change the test password in **Settings › Account** before other people can reach the server. Open and sign in. The app then shows the commands that connect your computer. See [Install with Docker Compose](https://docs.heylinger.com/install/docker-compose) to serve other computers on your network and to turn on voice. #### Local models The Compose containers run only the Linger server; models and agents run on the computer you connect. Run the guided installer on that computer: ```bash # macOS (Apple silicon) or Linux ./scripts/install/install.sh ``` ```powershell # Windows (x64, ordinary non-elevated PowerShell) powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File .\scripts\install\install.ps1 ``` It checks your hardware, installs and verifies a local model after your approval, and connects `linger-computer` to your Linger server. Pass `--help` for day-2 commands (`--status`, `--up`, `--remove`), or see [Bring your own runtime](docs/local-inference.md) for other model setups. If Compose ports are busy, the installer offers to select free ports. It saves LiveKit's port mappings and matching RTC startup arguments in `.local/compose.ports.yml` and enables the override through `.env`. This requires Docker Compose 2.24.4 or later. Rerunning the installer reuses those ports. ## Learn more The full documentation lives at **[docs.heylinger.com](https://docs.heylinger.com/)**.

## Contributors

New here? Read the [contribution guide](CONTRIBUTING.md) and pick a [good first issue](https://github.com/simplexai-labs/linger/issues?q=is%3Aissue%20state%3Aopen%20label%3A%22good%20first%20issue%22). ## Community & Contact Choose the channel that best fits your question: - [GitHub Issues](https://github.com/simplexai-labs/linger/issues): report reproducible bugs and track engineering work. Read the [contribution guide](CONTRIBUTING.md) before opening one. - [Email](mailto:tonyzhang@simplexai.com): write to tonyzhang@simplexai.com for anything that does not fit an issue. - [Security policy](SECURITY.md): report a vulnerability privately, never in a public issue. Star Linger on GitHub to follow along, and choose **Watch → Custom → Releases** to hear about every new release. ## Acknowledgements Linger is built on these open-source projects: - **[PolyStrata](https://github.com/simplexai-labs/PolyStrata):** Runs local models, keeping the experts a model uses most on your GPU. - **[Strata](https://github.com/Niko1221/Strata):** The inference engine PolyStrata is built on. It runs Qwen3.8-Flash-Next. - **[BlockNote](https://github.com/TypeCellOS/BlockNote), [Yjs](https://github.com/yjs/yjs) and [Hocuspocus](https://github.com/ueberdosis/hocuspocus):** Power the documents that people and agents edit together. - **[Hindsight](https://github.com/vectorize-io/hindsight):** Where agent memory's fact extraction and search come from. - **[Cua](https://github.com/trycua/cua):** Lets agents use the apps on your desktop. - **[LiveKit](https://github.com/livekit/livekit):** Carries the audio for voice and meetings. - **[River](https://github.com/riverqueue/river):** Runs TeamHub's background jobs. - **[NOTICE](NOTICE):** Lists every third-party component, what we adapted from it, and the license that applies. Thank you to the open-source community for libraries this powerful and this simple: they let us focus on the product itself, and we hope our projects will in turn give everyone an easier-to-use knowledge base. ## Feature Request Have an idea? [Open a feature request](https://github.com/simplexai-labs/linger/issues/new?template=feature_request.yml) and describe the problem it would solve. ## Star History ## License This repository is licensed under the [Linger Open Source License](LICENSE), based on Apache 2.0 with additional conditions.
